title: The last Sunday
logline: One more. The droplet falls. The walk into fog.

margin.note: The gull and the scruff both. Below, too small for newsprint: thank you for reading.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the garage studio, gray morning. The drafting table with sixteen years of tape ghosts on its edge. The three-legged dog in the doorway, wanting the walk. WOOD at the table, coat already on.

characters.pose: at the table with his coat on

props: tape ghosts on the table edge

image.prompt: a wide gray-morning view of a garage art studio, a drafting table edge scarred with years of tape ghosts, a small three-legged dog waiting in the open doorway, a man at the table already wearing his coat, watercolor softening into ochre and slate

panels.name: One more

panels.composition: Tier 2: the table from above. A daily grid, four panels. Panel 1: the 1997 cafeteria redrawn in the 2020 hand — the tray, the corn, the lunch lady. Panel 2: the same cafeteria, empty. Panels 3 and 4: blank.
props: a four-panel daily on the board, two panels drawn, two blank

image.prompt: looking straight down at a drafting table: a four-panel comic strip in progress, the first panel a cafeteria serving line with a lunch lady drawn in confident ink, the second the same cafeteria empty, the third and fourth panels blank white, brushes and a lamp at the edges
image.notes: A strip within the strip. The generator may draw the inner panels loosely; they should read as ink drawings on paper.

panels.name: The grid

panels.composition: Tier 3: the brush over Panel 3. The droplet. This time it drops — a single black bead on the white, dead center, where a figure would go.

characters.pose: hand only, brush releasing a drop

props: a single ink drop landing on blank paper

image.prompt: tight close-up of a sable brush above blank paper as a single heavy drop of black ink falls and lands dead center, clean razor line, no crosshatching

panels.name: The drop

panels.composition: Tier 4: the beach. Wood and the dog at the tide line from behind, walking away into fog, sketchbook under his arm. Sandpipers. No balloon.

characters.pose: walking away along the tide line, sketchbook under arm

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog seen from behind walking away along a tide line into fog, sketchbook under the man's arm, sandpipers scattering, muted ochre, slate blue and sea-foam watercolor

panels.name: Into fog

notes: The last public strip. Announced nowhere.
